neighbours.label: the word that sets up an 'as ADJ as X' / 'like X' example (even something ___ as simple as)
fire: Even something as small as a missing comma can crash the whole program.
It is hard to believe that someone as careful as Maria forgot her passport.
The fix could be as easy as restarting the router once a week.
A task as dull as sorting receipts suddenly felt rewarding.
Nobody expected something as ordinary as a sandwich to start the argument.
For someone as busy as a surgeon, an hour of free time is rare.
Sometimes something as cheap as a new pillow fixes your back pain.
The danger in a material as brittle as glass is the sudden crack.

notes: card: peaks on ' something', ' as', ' someone' before 'as simple as' examples; output suppresses like/such/as, so the pole marks positions where an exemplifying comparison is coming. Near misses say the same thing without the construction.
